title: Kiosk direction on iPhone
lede: The kiosk's pattern (one decision per screen, chips for the answer, one big button) brought to the reservation flow, Extend, Edit Booking, Add Shift, Availability and Notifications.

stats.n: Same simulator, fixture scenario, appearance and status-bar clock on both sides.
Event path: Choose Event, pick, confirm, Choose Gear before; suggested event, Choose Gear after.
iOS, student-field and schedule suites on the final source; assertions in 6 test files updated to the new layout.

sections.heading: New reservation
sections.note: Baseline: clean HEAD 2b2a3cfb. After: working tree. Fixture: create-booking-events.

pairs.title: Step 1
pairs.beforeCap: A segmented toggle and one row; the next shift is not offered.
pairs.afterCap: "What's this for?" with a suggested next shift and a single bottom button.

pairs.title: Event picker
pairs.beforeCap: Stock list, past events first (Sep 11, Sep 22), tiny radio circles, a faint toolbar check.
pairs.afterCap: Grouped Today/Tomorrow, solid chips, and a "Use N events" button.

pairs.title: Event linked
pairs.sub: VB vs Nebraska, same event both sides.
pairs.beforeCap: Schedule, title, pickup and return pickers all on one screen.
pairs.afterCap: Pickup and return collapsed to two lines with Change; Choose Gear goes straight to gear.

pairs.title: Gear, one item picked
pairs.beforeCap: Cart bubble, battery banner and Review pill float over the list.
pairs.afterCap: One bottom bar: count on the left, an honest action on the right.

pairs.title: Extend booking
pairs.beforeCap: A calendar graphic at minute resolution; the next booking's limit is only a line of text on the detail screen.
pairs.afterCap: Due header, "Can go until", a Needed Next card, day and time chips, a Latest chip and one button.

pairs.title: Edit booking
pairs.beforeCap: A date chip plus two dropdown menus in one cramped row.
pairs.afterCap: Due-back pill, Today/Tomorrow/Other date, suggested times and the 15-minute wheel.

sections.heading: Schedule and settings
sections.note: Fixtures: schedule (Volleyball vs Nebraska), schedule menu, notifications.

pairs.title: Add shift
pairs.beforeCap: Outlined area buttons and a call-window toggle.
pairs.afterCap: Area chips with fill (2/2, 1/2, 0/1), a How-many stepper and call-time presets.

pairs.title: Availability editor
pairs.afterCap: Chips for signal, repeat, day and time presets; Add button at the bottom.

pairs.title: Notifications
pairs.afterCap: Overnight, Late night and Evenings presets above the pickers.

changes.h: The next shift is the first suggestion
changes.was: Reservations started from a blank Choose Event row.
changes.now: The next shift's event is offered on step 1; tapping it fills the event, times, location and Choose Gear. Event-linked reservations skip the separate times screen.

changes.h: Return time is a decision, not a form
changes.was: Dropdowns and calendars at minute resolution.
changes.now: Today, Tomorrow or another date, three suggested times, and a 15-minute wheel. The Extend sheet also caps choices at the next booking's need, less a 30-minute grace.

changes.was: Three floating controls overlapped rows, and Review silently switched the filter to Batteries even after the suggestion was dismissed.
changes.now: A single bar with the item count and a labelled action. Dismissing the battery suggestion now lets Review through.

changes.h: Add Shift can add several slots
changes.was: One slot at a time, with area counts hidden.
changes.now: Each area chip shows its fill, the last area is remembered, and up to six slots are added in one go.

verification: iOS Wisconsin and WisconsinKiosk builds: both BUILD SUCCEEDED on the final source; the Wisconsin device build is installed on an iPhone 16 Pro.

Vitest: the iOS, student-field and schedule suites pass (124 files / 695 tests) on the final source. The full suite has 4 failing files (tests/hiring-*), which fail to load on an unrelated Prisma enum error (APPLIED undefined).
Fixture captures prove presentation only. Nothing was submitted: Create Reservation, Extend, Add Shift and Availability Add were not pressed, so server behavior is unverified.
Final source patch (HEAD plus uncommitted and new files) is retained as after-source.patch in this folder.
notes: Add Shift Custom state is shown after-only (after/add-shift-custom.png). The baseline (before/add-shift-custom.png) overflows the sheet width and wraps the End label one letter per line; the after capture was scrolled to reach the rows, so the scroll positions do not match and it is not offered as a pair.
The Availability editor capture was retaken after a one-line layout fix; the other after captures were taken just before it. That fix touches only the Availability editor.
Fixture dates are relative to launch, so some times (for example due-back) differ by minutes between sides while the status bar is pinned to 9:41.
Not built: copying the previous event's crew into Add Shift (needs new logic to find and copy slots); a before/after for the Review step and the Custom pause sheet.
Baseline captured from an isolated worktree at HEAD 2b2a3cfb; the checkout was clean at session start.
